contract: GET /api/libraries/:id/opml answers an application/xml OPML 1.0 document for a caller who may access the library, listing each podcast of the library that has a feed URL as one rss outline carrying type, text and title (the podcast title) and xmlUrl (the feed URL) plus the escaped description and the language when the podcast has them; the generator never writes htmlUrl, skips podcasts without a feed URL, and filters the list by the caller's explicit-content and tag permissions. Unauthenticated is 401, an admin without the library is 403 and an unknown library id is 404.
evidence: go-backend/testmachine/scenarios/podcast_feed: the four OPML scenarios pass against pinned upstream in two consecutive full packet runs
exceptions:
The stored description is escaped by opmlGenerator escapeForXML and again by the XML serializer, so a podcast description "

Signal description

" appears as <p>Signal <b>description</b></p> in the attribute; the scenario pins that value.
opmlGenerator tests podcast.itunesPageUrl although the model attribute is itunesPageURL, so the htmlUrl attribute is never written; the scenario asserts its absence.

invariants.contract: GET /api/libraries/:id/opml answers 401 without a token, 403 for an admin whose librariesAccessible does not contain the library and 404 for an unknown library id, and a rejected request returns no document.

An accepted request answers 200 with Content-Type application/xml and an OPML 1.0 document whose head title is "Audiobookshelf Podcast Subscriptions"; the body holds exactly one rss outline per podcast of the library that has a feedURL, with text and title equal to the podcast title, xmlUrl equal to the feedURL, description equal to the escaped stored description when set, language when set and no htmlUrl attribute, and no outline for a podcast without a feedURL; a library without podcasts answers the same document with an empty body.

The outline set is filtered by the caller, not by the admin role: a user without accessExplicitContent receives every subscription except an explicit podcast, and a user with accessAllTags false whose itemTagsSelected do not match receives every subscription except the podcast carrying that tag, while both keep the remaining outlines.
